item.title: His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz held official talks at the Federal Chancellery i…
item.description:
His Highness the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz held official talks at the Federal Chancellery in Berlin on Friday afternoon, covering the development of ties in the economy, investment and energy, as well as Middle East developments. The two leaders then witnessed the signing of four documents: a security cooperation agreement between the two interior ministries, another between the Internal Security Force (Lekhwiya) and Germany's Federal Ministry of the Interior, a military cooperation agreement, and a letter of intent between the two foreign ministries on cooperation in peace, reconciliation and dispute settlement.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/amir-german-chancellor-hold-official-talks-session-2 · The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/amir-german-chancellor-witness-signing-of-several-agreements · Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738646/qatar/amir-merz-chart-new-course-for-bilateral-ties · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/qatar-and-germany-deepen-strategic-ties-during-emirs-berlin-visit

item.title: In joint press statements with Chancellor Merz, His Highness the Amir said Qatar regards Germany as an important partner with a friendship …
item.description:
In joint press statements with Chancellor Merz, His Highness the Amir said Qatar regards Germany as an important partner with a friendship spanning decades, that its long-term investments in Germany reflect confidence in the strength of its economy and industrial expertise, and that energy cooperation is founded on trust and commitment and supports security of supply and market stability. His Highness stressed respect for state sovereignty and international law and prioritising dialogue and diplomacy in resolving disputes, while Merz acknowledged Qatar's mediation between the United States and Iran and called for the Strait of Hormuz to reopen permanently.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/joint-press-statements-of-amir-german-chancellor · Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738651/qatar/qatar-and-germany-reaffirm-commitment-in-joint-statement · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/qatar-and-germany-deepen-strategic-ties-during-emirs-berlin-visit

item.title: Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani met German Foreign Minister Johann Wadep…
item.description:
Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani met German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul in Berlin on the sidelines of the Amir's visit, discussing bilateral ties, ongoing diplomatic efforts and joint coordination to de-escalate tensions in the region. He affirmed Qatar's support for all initiatives aimed at a solution that guarantees freedom of maritime navigation and paves the way for a comprehensive agreement achieving lasting peace.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/20/11/2026/prime-minister-meets-german-foreign-minister-3 · Gulf Times (QNA) https://www.gulf-times.com/article/738647/qatar/pm-german-fm-discuss-ties

item.title: Qatar called on the international community and its institutions to take swift, decisive action to deter Israeli aggression, warning that I…
item.description:
Qatar called on the international community and its institutions to take swift, decisive action to deter Israeli aggression, warning that Israel's continued undermining of the rules of international relations and its impunity pose a grave threat to regional and international security. The statement was delivered by Ambassador Jassim Yaqoub Al Hammadi, Permanent Representative to the UN and international organisations in Vienna, before the IAEA Board of Governors, and addressed crimes in the Gaza Strip, settler violence in the West Bank and the continued occupation of Syrian territory and parts of Lebanon.

item.title: Al Sadd took provisional top spot in the Doha Bank Stars League with a 3-2 win over Lusail at Jassim Bin Hamad Stadium in round 10, with al…
item.description:
Al Sadd took provisional top spot in the Doha Bank Stars League with a 3-2 win over Lusail at Jassim Bin Hamad Stadium in round 10, with all five goals coming in the first half: Khaled Mohammad opened for Lusail (6), Alessio Romagnoli equalised (23), Akram Afif scored twice (28 and a 38th-minute penalty), and Rodrigo Moreno pulled one back (45+3). In the other game, Al Duhail lost 2-1 to Qatar SC, leaving three clubs level on 21 points with Al Sadd ahead on goal difference, pending Al Rayyan's match against Al Shahania on Saturday.

item.title: The Department of Meteorology warned of strong winds and high seas offshore overnight into Saturday, with offshore winds reaching 23 knots …
item.description:
The Department of Meteorology warned of strong winds and high seas offshore overnight into Saturday, with offshore winds reaching 23 knots and waves rising to 7 feet, while inshore weather will be relatively cold with suspended dust to light fog in places and visibility falling to 3 km or less. On Friday morning the department had warned of poor horizontal visibility of 1 km or less in some coastal areas due to fog.

item.title: The Saudi-led coalition launched a 'special operation' on Friday targeting Hodeidah port and other sites in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz. Its spok…
item.description:
The Saudi-led coalition launched a 'special operation' on Friday targeting Hodeidah port and other sites in Sanaa, Saada and Taiz. Its spokesman Turki Al Malki said the strikes hit operational capabilities at the port used to smuggle and transport weapons and ballistic missiles, as well as missile and drone facilities and a supply depot in Sanaa. The Houthis had threatened to strike Jeddah and Red Sea ports if Hodeidah was hit, warned airlines away from Saudi airspace, and threatened a power station in Jizan and the King Abdullah Financial District.
Sources: Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/gulf/saudi/saudi-coalition-launches-special-operation-yemens-houthis-vow-reprisals-1.500755368 · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-war-6-key-updates-uae-residents-need-to-know-this-evening-november-20-1.500755450 · Al Jazeera English (AFP, Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/saudi-coalition-and-houthis-exchange-threats-to-bomb-key-ports

item.title: The coalition said it intercepted and destroyed two drones launched by the Houthis towards Riyadh and the southern region, while the Saudi …
item.description:
The coalition said it intercepted and destroyed two drones launched by the Houthis towards Riyadh and the southern region, while the Saudi Foreign Ministry said the kingdom will not tolerate attacks on its territory and assets and reserves the right to take the necessary measures to defend its sovereignty, calling on the Security Council to fulfil its responsibilities. Defence analysts say the Houthis are using a 'one-a-night' missile tactic to drain air defences, and a single ballistic missile was intercepted over southern Saudi Arabia on Friday.

item.title: Gulf condemnation mounted over the Houthi attacks on Riyadh that caused material damage to a tower in the King Abdullah Financial District …
item.description:
Gulf condemnation mounted over the Houthi attacks on Riyadh that caused material damage to a tower in the King Abdullah Financial District without casualties: Qatar condemned them in the strongest terms as a disgraceful aggression and a blatant violation of the kingdom's sovereignty and affirmed full solidarity, Kuwait denounced them as terrorist attacks, and Bahrain on Friday deemed them a blatant violation of Saudi sovereignty and a breach of international law.

item.title: The UAE Foreign Ministry denounced what it called the Somali government's 'escalatory and hostile approach', regretting attempts to drag in…
item.description:
The UAE Foreign Ministry denounced what it called the Somali government's 'escalatory and hostile approach', regretting attempts to drag internal power struggles into bilateral relations, after Mogadishu expelled the UAE ambassador and gave him 72 hours to leave. The UAE noted it had closed its Mogadishu embassy in January after the Somali government cancelled bilateral agreements, while the GCC condemned 'irresponsible statements' by Somali officials.

item.title: The 47th Cairo International Film Festival, which screened 145 films from 64 countries between 11 and 20 November, closed at the Cairo Oper…
item.description:
The 47th Cairo International Film Festival, which screened 145 films from 64 countries between 11 and 20 November, closed at the Cairo Opera House on Friday evening. Adrian Goiginger's 'Four Minus Three' won the Golden Pyramid for best film, along with best actress for Valerie Pachner and best supporting actor. The Silver Pyramid for best director went to Rudi Rosenberg for 'Words of Love', the Bronze to Ashjan Al Hams's 'Al Baraniya', 'Summer Pastures' won best Arab feature, and cinematographer Said Shimy received the lifetime achievement pyramid.

item.title: Gold kept falling in the Egyptian market through Friday's close: 21-carat dropped from EGP 5,670 at the open to EGP 5,550 in the evening an…
item.description:
Gold kept falling in the Egyptian market through Friday's close: 21-carat dropped from EGP 5,670 at the open to EGP 5,550 in the evening and then to EGP 5,475 (selling) at the close, while 24-carat stood near EGP 6,255. The gold pound lost about EGP 960 during the day to roughly EGP 44,400 in the evening before trading at EGP 43,800 at the close, tracking the global ounce's fall to near USD 3,521.

item.title: Gold prospectors and tribe members in Aswan and the Red Sea began handing over hundreds of kilograms of stored gold, along with 33 automati…
item.description:
Gold prospectors and tribe members in Aswan and the Red Sea began handing over hundreds of kilograms of stored gold, along with 33 automatic rifles and two machine guns, under the presidential initiative to regularise prospectors' status, according to MP Mostafa Bakry, who said the Future of Egypt agency pays the gold's value immediately after deducting the state's share. Bakry expected a large part of the problems to be resolved within 15 days and the crisis to be fully settled within a month and a half.

item.description:
Aswan Governor Amr Lashin inspected Aswan International Airport's readiness to receive about 400 ministerial figures and representatives of regional and international organisations taking part in the sixth Aswan Forum for Sustainable Peace and Development on 21 and 22 November, in coordination with the Foreign Ministry. item.description:
Al Ahly are preparing to face Pyramids on Monday 23 November at 8pm Cairo time at Cairo International Stadium in round nine of the Premier League, with coach Hussein Ammouta holding a video session with the players. item.title: Wall Street ended the week with steep losses: the Nasdaq closed down 5.28% at 22,617.73, erasing its gains for the year, the S&P 500 fell 3…
item.description:
Wall Street ended the week with steep losses: the Nasdaq closed down 5.28% at 22,617.73, erasing its gains for the year, the S&P 500 fell 3.69% to 6,910.77 and the Dow dropped 1.93% to 48,147.42, with the latter two entering correction territory more than 10% below their peaks. Chip stocks led the sell-off, the VIX fear gauge jumped to 37.73, its highest level of 2026, and the 10-year Treasury yield fell to 4.91% as investors sought safe havens.

item.title: Gold is heading for its biggest weekly loss in eight months after falling about 9.2% since the start of the week and touching its lowest si…
item.description:
Gold is heading for its biggest weekly loss in eight months after falling about 9.2% since the start of the week and touching its lowest since September 2025, pressured by a dollar near a 19-month high and expectations of a Fed rate hike next month. Futures ended Friday down 4.34% at USD 3,525.50, spot silver slipped to USD 41.25 an ounce, and bitcoin dropped below USD 59,000 to its lowest since July.

item.title: Britain and the European Union announced at a summit in Brussels on Friday a 'reset' deal a decade after the Brexit vote, including timelin…
item.description:
Britain and the European Union announced at a summit in Brussels on Friday a 'reset' deal a decade after the Brexit vote, including timelines for a youth mobility scheme allowing up to 100,000 young people from each side to live, work and study in the other for up to three years, and a sanitary and phytosanitary agreement cutting barriers to food trade. Prime Minister Andy Burnham said the deal would give the UK economy a GBP 17 billion boost and add up to 0.5% to GDP.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/eu-and-uk-seal-reset-deal · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/europe/2026/11/20/brexit-reset-17bn-boost-as-britain-strikes-new-deal-with-eu/

item.title: Russia launched one of its largest attacks on Ukraine overnight into Friday with more than 80 missiles and 400 drones, killing at least sev…
item.description:
Russia launched one of its largest attacks on Ukraine overnight into Friday with more than 80 missiles and 400 drones, killing at least seven people in Kyiv and two in Lviv and hitting three vital bridges, in retaliation for the strike on the Crimea bridge. Poland accused Moscow of 'provocation' after three airspace violations and is investigating a site where an object likely fell and started a fire in the village of Chmielek, about 45 km from the Ukrainian border, while France requested a Security Council meeting.

item.title: Iraqi security forces entered Jurf al-Sakhar in Babil province on Friday, a Kataib Hezbollah stronghold for more than a decade, with tanks …
item.description:
Iraqi security forces entered Jurf al-Sakhar in Babil province on Friday, a Kataib Hezbollah stronghold for more than a decade, with tanks and armoured vehicles under a compromise deal relocating the group's members, as federal police take over a new joint security headquarters protecting oil facilities. Prime Minister Ali Al Zaidi said the move marks the start of asserting state authority nationwide, after a probe raised suspicions that hundreds of millions of dollars' worth of oil had been stolen through illicit refineries.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/iraqi-forces-deploy-to-jurf-al-sakhar-after-deal-with-iran-backed-group · The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/mena/2026/11/20/iraqi-security-forces-move-into-iran-backed-militia-stronghold-of-jurf-al-sakhar/

item.title: Protesters, mostly young people, rallied in 25 European countries on Friday against high living costs, rising rents, military spending, the…
item.description:
Protesters, mostly young people, rallied in 25 European countries on Friday against high living costs, rising rents, military spending, the climate crisis and deteriorating learning conditions, in marches coordinated by a youth coalition of more than 50 groups from Italy to Germany, Austria and Britain under the slogan 'fight for our future'. The protests are set to extend into the weekend with trade unions and housing associations joining.
Sources: Al Jazeera English (AP, Reuters) https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/20/protests-held-across-europe-over-wages-services-high-living-costs · Oman Observer (Reuters) https://www.omanobserver.om/article/1199976/world/europe/young-protesters-hit-the-streets-across-europe
